items.title: Ruthie Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 28, 2023
items.q: out came the Edwin Hawkins Singers

ctx.x: Well thank you. I’m happy to be here, I really am.

I was, on the way up today, you know I’ve been actually looking forward to this for a few years now, and I was a tad nervous about getting things going and how to get the interview started. But I do believe in coincidences because I turned on in the car Sirius Radio and out came the Edwin Hawkins Singers singing “O Happy Day.”
